title: UMG Declared MOLT Types Registry Schema
description: Schema for registry/declared_molt_types.json. Contains two sections: composite_molt_types (products of cross-type MOLT block merges) and output_composites (products of OutputBlueprintResolver). Base MOLT types are stable and not declared here.

composite_molt_types.description: Declared composite MOLT types. Products of cross-type block merges. Participate in vertical hierarchy. Do not add to base MOLT taxonomy.

output_composites.description: Declared output composite types. Products of OutputBlueprintResolver. Blueprint/format resolution products only. Not MOLT types.

CompositeMoltType.description: A declared composite MOLT type produced by merging two or more blocks of different base MOLT types.

type_id.description: Unique identifier. PascalCase. Should describe the coherent function created by the merge. Examples: GovernedInstruction, SovereignAnalysisFrame, PhilosophyDirective.

kind.description: Always 'composite' for declared composite MOLT types.

composed_from.description: Base MOLT types that compose this type. Order matters — first listed = dominant unless authority_behavior specifies otherwise.

authority_behavior.description: How vertical authority resolves within this composite. Examples: directive_governs_instruction, philosophy_informs_directive, subject_constrains_instruction.

runtime_role.description: Human-readable description of what this composite does at runtime.

merge_allowed.description: Whether this composite type can itself be a source in a further merge.

requires_coherence_claim.description: Whether a merge producing this type must include a coherence_claim.

validation_path.description: Default validation path for merges that produce this type. rule_validated = auto-approved. declared_composite_match = registry match is sufficient. sovereign_pending = always requires review.

dominant_component.description: Which composed_from type holds authority in conflict. If omitted, first in composed_from wins.

OutputComposite.description: A declared output composite type produced by OutputBlueprintResolver when multiple lanes produce conflicting Blueprint preferences.

type_id.description: Unique identifier. PascalCase. Examples: StructuredIdeationMap, AnalyticalNarrative, GovernedReleaseReport.

composed_from_lanes.description: The horizontal lanes whose Blueprint outputs were in conflict and resolved into this composite.

resolution_policy.description: How the resolver combines the competing Blueprint preferences. Examples: analysis_structure_with_creative_content, audit_driven_with_planning_sections, governance_framed_technical_output.

blueprint_behavior.description: Concrete description of the output format produced by this composite. Used by the Blueprint layer to shape actual response structure.

valid_when.description: Activation conditions for this output composite.

lanes_active.description: Lanes that must be active for this composite to be a valid resolution.

blueprint_conflict.description: Whether a Blueprint-level conflict must be present to activate this composite.

minimum_lane_weight.description: Minimum weight for each active lane to qualify. Optional.

suppresses_lanes.description: Lane IDs whose standalone Blueprint output is suppressed in favor of this composite.

baseMoltTypes.description: Stable base MOLT type set. Do not modify. These are not declared here — they are built into the runtime.

seededCompositeMoltTypes.runtime_role: Executes an instruction under an explicit governing directive. The directive sets the boundary; the instruction executes within it.
A governed analytical frame combining a scoping directive, an analytical instruction, and a defined subject domain. Used for bounded research and audit tasks.
A directive whose behavioral scope is shaped by a philosophical worldview. The directive governs action; the philosophy constrains the ethical lens.
seededCompositeMoltTypes.notes: Philosophy + Directive composites require sovereign review — the risk of incoherent philosophy-directive binding is higher than other composites.

seededCompositeMoltTypes.runtime_role: An instruction governed by a directive, applied to a specific subject domain. More specific than GovernedInstruction — the subject constrains scope.
A primary outcome value governed by a directive. The directive constrains which outcomes are acceptable.

seededOutputComposites.blueprint_behavior: Structured sections defined by analytical decomposition, with open generative content within each section. Headers are analytical; body is exploratory.
Formal structured report. Governance summary first. Audit findings second. Output artifacts third. All sections traceable to governing directives.
Analytical decomposition of current state. Audit findings on gaps and risks. Planning sections for remediation. Roadmap appended.
